topic: How does defocused feed array placement optimize coverage versus scan loss in DBF architectures?
consensus_response: Defocused feed array placement optimizes coverage by reducing scan loss, spillover loss, and taper loss through digital beamforming techniques. This balance affects system performance, with defocusing reducing gain loss due to feed failures, thus enhancing system robustness and service availability in challenging channel conditions.
reference_context: Defocused reflector concepts minimize sidelobes and maximize gain in desired cells, improving system performance and service availability.
